description:
Use this when the user wants an editing style other creators share: "show me community presets", "is there a
gaming preset". Returns each preset's preset_id, what it carries, how many used it and whether it needs Premium.
Not for: the user's own templates (edit_catalog) or clipping presets (list_clipping_presets). Free and read
only.

category.description: A category name such as hype or podcast (the answer lists them). Empty means every category.

limit.description: How many presets to return, 1 to 50.

query.description: Words that must all appear in a preset's name, creator, description or category, e.g. gaming. Empty lists all.

name: browse_presets
title: Browse community presets
